hero.title: Bloodborne PC
hero.description: Bloodborne PC is finally real — just not the way anyone expected. In October 2026, roughly eleven years after the PS4 original, the unofficial bbport project brought FromSoftware's gothic masterpiece to Windows as a native port: real graphics settings, quality-of-life improvements, up to 100 FPS and beyond on capable hardware, working online functionality with its own matchmaking website, and even mouse controls. It runs well even on low-end machines at 60 FPS, and there's a Linux port too. This wiki tracks Bloodborne PC from day one: how to install the bbport, how to tune performance, how online play works, and how the port compares to the shadPS4 emulator route.

aboutGame.title: What Is Bloodborne PC?
paragraphs: Bloodborne PC is the community's answer to eleven years of waiting. FromSoftware's 2015 gothic horror masterpiece — the blood-drenched streets of Yharnam, the trick weapons, the frenetic combat that defined a subgenre — was locked to PlayStation hardware while every sibling in the Souls lineage migrated to PC. The unofficial bbport project changed that in October 2026: a native Windows port, not an emulation layer, with extensive PC options — resolution and graphics settings, quality-of-life improvements, uncapped frame rates reaching 100 FPS on mainstream GPUs, working online functionality with its own matchmaking website, and even mouse controls. It reportedly runs well even on low-end hardware at 60 FPS, with a Linux port following.

The port is not complete end-to-end — later sections of the game may still have issues, and it exists in the same legal gray as every beloved unofficial port. But for a game whose PC absence became a running joke in the community — a former Sony executive called the lack of a port a mystery even to himself — the bbport is the dream delivered, warts and all. This wiki covers it honestly: what works, what doesn't, how to set it up and how it compares to the alternatives.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Bloodborne PC and the bbport.

items.question: Is there an official Bloodborne PC version?
items.answer: No. Sony has never released Bloodborne on PC, and former executive Shuhei Yoshida called the lack of a port a mystery even to himself. The bbport is an unofficial community project — not licensed by Sony or FromSoftware.

items.question: What is the bbport?
items.answer: An unofficial native Windows port of Bloodborne released in October 2026, roughly 11 years after the PS4 original. It runs the game natively on PC with real graphics settings, QoL improvements, working online play, mouse controls and frame rates up to 100 FPS and beyond.

items.question: Does online play work on the Bloodborne PC port?
items.answer: Yes — the port includes working online functionality with its own matchmaking website, restoring co-op and invasion play that unofficial ports rarely manage. The online guide covers the setup and flow.

items.question: Is the port complete?
items.answer: Mostly — it runs the game from start to finish, but reporting notes it isn't complete end-to-end, and later sections may still have issues. It's a community project in active development, improving on the update cycle. The shadPS4 emulator route is the fully-complete alternative.
